heading: Booking terms
disclaimer: These booking terms are not final.

sections.heading: 1. Subject of the rental
sections.text: The subject of the rental is Luuppi ry's facility Pii-Klubi, located at Yliopistonkatu 58 B, 0th floor, 33100 Tampere. The rental includes the function hall, the gallery and the sauna facilities.

sections.heading: 2. Booking terms
items: On Thu-Fri, the rental period starts at the earliest at 17:00 and ends at 04:00, unless otherwise agreed.
The basic rental period on Sat-Sun is at most 12 hours, starting at the earliest at 12:00 and ending at the latest at 06:00. The end time is determined by the start time, unless otherwise agreed.
The booking is considered to begin from the moment the keys are handed over to the renter. Additional hours cost €50/4h.
The rental includes the use of the facilities, chairs and tables, use of the kitchen and tableware, and restrooms, for which the landlord takes care of restocking paper supplies.

sections.heading: 3. Payment and cancellation terms
items: The renter of the facilities must be of legal age.

A booking can be cancelled free of charge up to 2 weeks before the booking date. Bookings cancelled less than two weeks in advance will be charged half the invoice, and bookings cancelled less than a week in advance will be charged the full price. A booking can be rescheduled free of charge at the latest 2 weeks before the booked date.
Any broken or lost equipment will be invoiced after the event.

Due to a force majeure event (e.g. water damage, fire, vandalism), the landlord may cancel the booking without liability for compensation before the booking begins. In this case, the renter is entitled to a full refund of the amount paid.

sections.heading: 4. Food and drinks
items: Bringing your own food and drinks to the premises is allowed.
The renter is responsible for the use of the kitchen and its safety during the rental period.
Drinking alcohol or carrying open drinks in the stairwell or the courtyard is not allowed.

sections.heading: 5. Cleaning
items: The renter must use the facilities in a clean and orderly manner and with good manners. The premises must be left in a reasonable condition after the event.

The renter must put used items, equipment and dishes back clean in their places, wipe counters and floors, vacuum the entrance mats, and remove their own belongings and trash from the premises within the rental period. The renter must also take care of the cleanliness of the yard areas. More detailed cleaning instructions can be found in the renter's folder.

A fee of €200.00 is charged for neglecting cleaning. Unreported glass shards left on the floor are always grounds for a cleaning invoice. If the premises require extensive cleaning, an additional cleaning cost of €30/h will be added.

sections.heading: 6. Rules and safety
items: A maximum of 200 people may be present in the function hall at the same time.
The renter is obliged to familiarize themselves with the instructions given for using the equipment and to follow them.
The renter is responsible for the safety of their event. The landlord is not liable for injuries.
If any areas have been closed off from use, this will be clearly marked by the landlord. This restriction must be strictly followed.

The landlord and the authorities have the right to interrupt the event if it is considered to cause danger to the property, belongings, or nuisance to the neighborhood or environment. The event may also be interrupted if the rental terms are not followed.
Candles may not be lit and smoke machines may not be used indoors. Any unwarranted fire alarms will be invoiced to the renter.
Smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas. Smoking is only allowed in the designated area in the courtyard. Smoking next to the outer door is strictly prohibited.
Loitering in the stairwell is strictly prohibited.
The renter is responsible for ensuring that everyone attending the event follows the rental terms.

sections.heading: 7. Damages and compensation
items: A key to the function hall is handed over to the renter at the start of the rental period. A €100 fee is charged for a lost key.

The renter is obliged to compensate for damage caused to the premises, the property owner and/or a third party in connection with the rental. The renter is also responsible for damage arising or discovered after the rental period that was caused by the actions or negligence of those present in the premises.

If, after an event, the premises require additional cleaning or repair due to damage or vandalism (e.g. vomit, stains on the walls, etc.), the landlord will invoice these separately after the event. The renter is obliged to report any broken dishes, other damaged belongings, or damage caused to the property. We charge the replacement cost for broken or missing dishes and cutlery.

If, after the event, the landlord receives complaints due to the renter's actions regarding misuse of the smoking area and/or the stairwell, the renter will receive a temporary rental ban on the premises as well as a cleaning invoice if needed.
The landlord does not compensate the renter for damage caused by a force majeure event, nor under any circumstances for indirect damages.

sections.heading: 8. Complaints
items: Any complaints regarding the premises must be submitted at the latest on the first business day following the rental, to toimitila@luuppi.fi

sections.heading: 9. Other
items: The landlord reserves the right to make changes to the terms of order and delivery as well as to prices.

sections.heading: 10. Entry into force of the agreement
items: The agreement enters into force upon the renter's booking request and is binding on both parties.
